title: Accept layout text from unidentified keys
changes: Preserve text reported for an unidentified physical key in the command console, while keeping modifier, context and active-composition guards.
validation: Windows GNU runtime and test builds passed; Wine tests cover unidentified layout text and guards. An isolated Italian-layout Wine GUI inserted è and preserved guest frame, clock, state, registers and input.
limitations: This verifies one simulated Italian key under Wine; other layouts, physical inputs, native Windows and real IME in the console remain unverified under DBG2-14.
